en: An illustrated historical scene in winter showing King Charles IX (Kaarle IX / Karl den IX) on horseback in fur-trimmed clothing, meeting a delegation of peasants. The peasants, dressed in simple 17th‑century garments, approach respectfully, some holding documents. In the background stands a large stone church or castle-like building and additional figures. The caption in Finnish and Swedish is printed along the bottom margin.
